paragraphs.text: Atla Palani is a noble shaman of the Sun Empire on Ixalan . She is a member of one of Atzocan 's three major families.

Atla Palani considers all life precious and has a deep bond with dinosaurs that allows her to bond with them while they are still in the egg . By encouraging and guiding them before they hatch, she ensures that the connection between the Sun Empire and the dinosaurs will never falter.
